import_configuration.format: Node3D PackedScene wrapping three stage-specific GLB groups
import_configuration.up_axis: Godot Y up via glTF export

instructions: Refine the v008 high-detail component-level hard-surface Blender model in response to its strict review. Keep the three construction-stage groups and exact gameplay footprint. Batch all parts within each stage by PBR material, unwrap each batch, and bake subtle candidate-local base-color and roughness variation. Replace the smooth pale drum winding with three braided hemp strands and a darker, rougher rope finish; retain the bevelled gear, fitted bearing details, formed copper plumbing, gauges, and rounded mast/rungs. Preserve the gameplay-owned deployment cable, stage gates, anchors, navigation, collision, selection, construction, and traversal. Render the actual RoomScale construction, complete, deployment, room, three-quarter, opposite, profile, and detail views. Compare strict realism, craftsmanship, surface response, hardware, production draw calls and warmed performance against grapple-v006; do not promote unless every strict gate passes and the challenger clearly beats the incumbent.
material_method: Distinct Principled PBR wood, forged iron, satin steel, brass, copper, rope, enamel, and blackened-steel materials on bevelled component-level geometry

changes_from_v008: baked subtle PBR albedo and roughness maps
parameters.material_variation: 512px packed candidate-local sRGB albedo and non-color roughness textures with subtle tileable procedural variation
parameters.mesh_batching: one exported mesh per unique PBR material within each construction-stage group

post_processing: Export three candidate-local GLB stage groups and a Node3D PackedScene wrapper
Godot-import and validate bounds and all stage-group nodes
Capture construction, grapple-complete, grapple-deployment, room, three-quarter, opposite-three-quarter, profile, and detail production views
Record strict visual-gate answers, defects, and best-so-far comparison
tool: Blender hard-surface model generator through the RoomScale Art Factory
tool_version: Blender 5.2.3 LTS; Godot 4.7.2-stable Compatibility production renderer
